title: Sparkly planet with rings
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='planetGrad' cx='38%' cy='35%' r='70%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffd27a'/>
      <stop offset='60%' stop-color='#f2963c'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#c25a1e'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- sparkles behind -->
  <g fill='#ffe98a'>
    <circle cx='14' cy='22' r='1.6'/>
    <circle cx='86' cy='30' r='1.3'/>
    <circle cx='20' cy='78' r='1.4'/>
    <circle cx='80' cy='80' r='1.6'/>
    <circle cx='50' cy='8' r='1.2'/>
    <circle cx='8' cy='52' r='1.2'/>
    <circle cx='92' cy='56' r='1.3'/>
  </g>
  <!-- back half of ring -->
  <path d='M18 62 Q50 30 82 62' fill='none' stroke='#9fe6ff' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.85'/>
  <!-- planet -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='26' fill='url(#planetGrad)'/>
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='45' rx='7' ry='3.5' fill='#ffe9b0' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- front half of ring -->
  <path d='M18 62 Q50 84 82 62' fill='none' stroke='#c9f3ff' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M18 62 Q50 84 82 62' fill='none' stroke='#7ed6f2' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- foreground sparkles -->
  <g fill='#ffffff'>
    <path d='M70 18 l1.5 4 l4 1.5 l-4 1.5 l-1.5 4 l-1.5 -4 l-4 -1.5 l4 -1.5 z'/>
    <path d='M28 24 l1.2 3 l3 1.2 l-3 1.2 l-1.2 3 l-1.2 -3 l-3 -1.2 l3 -1.2 z'/>
    <path d='M78 70 l1.2 3 l3 1.2 l-3 1.2 l-1.2 3 l-1.2 -3 l-3 -1.2 l3 -1.2 z'/>
    <path d='M16 44 l1 2.4 l2.4 1 l-2.4 1 l-1 2.4 l-1 -2.4 l-2.4 -1 l2.4 -1 z'/>

</svg>
